patterns.note: A minimalist, grid-based layout is used for displaying artworks, featuring generous whitespace around each piece and between sections.
A sophisticated serif font is used for all primary headings and body text, contrasted with a very small, uppercase sans-serif for navigation and UI labels.
The site employs a stark monochromatic palette of white, light grey, and black, with a single vibrant orange used sparingly as a strong accent for specific content blocks.

The initial hero section, featuring a white background, scrolls up to reveal the rest of the page content which sits on a consistent light grey background, while the main header and a newsletter 'CLOSE' button remain sticky at the top.
Artwork details are consistently presented with the image above, followed by the title, artist, medium, and year in a clear, structured text block.

technique_notes: The site utilizes a sticky header that remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, providing persistent navigation and branding.
A responsive grid system is implemented to display art pieces, adapting the number of columns based on screen size while maintaining consistent spacing.

The design employs a subtle background color shift: the initial hero section has a white background, which transitions to a light grey as the hero content scrolls out of view, creating a sense of depth and content reveal.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~4-5x body) with smaller, readable serif body text, and very small uppercase sans-serif labels for UI elements.
design_tokens.spacing: airy in hero and between major sections, with balanced spacing within content grids.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its sophisticated, almost editorial presentation of art, achieved through a stark monochromatic palette, generous whitespace, and a strong reliance on classic serif typography. The single, bold orange accent used sparingly provides a memorable visual punch against the otherwise subdued aesthetic.
